snippet.title: Full Steam Ahead
snippet.description:
Get Psyched - the funkiest FPS of all time is coming to Steam! Bunny hop into a new age of old-school shooters, wrapped up in the most stylish package around.
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3561320/Open_Fortress

CREDITS
Storyboard & 3D Animation: Silvermace
2D Animation: Shadok
Soundtrack: MrModez Pineapple
Voice Acting: Jonathan "Stachekip" Biondi, Squeegi
Writing: Jonathan "Stachekip" Biondi
SFX: Jonathan "Stachekip" Biondi
Mapping: Pigeon
Textures: Everik
Extra Assistance: Blamo, KrazyZark
Direction & Planning: Elliot

https://openfortress.fun/

Special thanks to Omniary for the extra sounds!
(Mercenary jump sounds and Tommy Gun sounds)
